buildCommand:
GOWORK=off GOFLAGS=-mod=vendor make -C agent deb-{{.Arch}} \
  VERSION="${BUILD_VERSION:?}" \
  NFPM_BIN=/usr/local/bin/nfpm \
  DEB_OUTPUT=/src/agent/bin/nvke-agent.deb
test -f "/src/agent/bin/nvke-agent.deb"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "/src/agent/bin/nvke-agent.deb" Package)" = "nvke-agent"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "/src/agent/bin/nvke-agent.deb" Architecture)" = "{{.Arch}}"

# Keep DHCP identity stable when NVKE moves L3 to its OVS bridge.
# Stage authored VM configuration; never modify the pinned source tree.
readonly files=/src/nvkr-output/native-image-files
mkdir -p "$files"
cp -a /src/os-image/files/. "$files/"
cat >"$files/00-dhcp-all.yaml" <<'NETPLAN'
network:
  version: 2
  renderer: networkd
  ethernets:
    all-en:
      match:
        name: "e*"
      dhcp4: true
      dhcp6: true
      dhcp-identifier: mac
      optional: true
NETPLAN
python3 /src/os-image/packer/scripts/compose-image-inputs.py \
  --architecture {{.Arch}} \
  --materials-dir /nvkr/inputs/materials \
  --source-files-dir "$files" \
  --output /src/nvkr-output/image-inputs.tar \
  --source-date-epoch "$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"
